entities.name: Query protein 768 aa
observations: Sequence length is 768 aa with predicted molecular mass 86.5 kDa and basic theoretical pI 9.53.
Pfam detects RuBisCO_large_N at residues 141–175 and RuBisCO_large at residues 185–493 with very strong significance (i-Evalue 1.7e-138).
Pfam also detects Ribosomal_L23 at residues 507–566 and Ycf4 at residues 577–722, indicating a fused or multidomain photosynthetic/chloroplast-associated protein architecture.
Raw Swiss-Prot-like homologs show approximately 96% identity over 47% of the query, but automated annotation transfer was not accepted because coverage was incomplete.
No explicit catalytic equation was returned by the sequence-analysis report; the Rubisco-domain assignment supports inference of RuBisCO catalytic activity, not direct experimental confirmation.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, homology hits, and Pfam domain assignments

entities.name: Ribulose bisphosphate carboxylase large chain
observations: The query contains the canonical Rubisco large-chain domain spanning approximately residues 141–493.

Rubisco large-chain proteins catalyze fixation of CO2 into ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate, producing two molecules of 3-phosphoglycerate; the oxygenase side reaction uses O2 and produces 2-phosphoglycolate plus 3-phosphoglycerate.
The exact reaction assignment remains homology/domain-based here because the tool did not retrieve a curated equation for the query sequence.

source_tools.relevance: Rubisco domain evidence and functional interpretation
